ThinkByte: Harsh Pandya, Pavan, Vigarna Ramesh, Raghu Gorrela, Harsha, vinay kovvuri, Charan Kumar
Sagniku
Sureshadhi
Rubynathm
Key Takeaways
The team discussed updating SEO content, focusing on refreshing existing blogs and adding new content to improve rankings.
There was a conversation about optimizing the website's user experience by removing unnecessary elements like the WhatsApp icon and adjusting the checkout process to improve conversion rates.
The team plans to experiment with Google and Meta ads, monitoring their performance closely to determine the best strategy for increasing engagement and conversions.
Shipping costs for international orders were analyzed, with a suggestion to explore local distributors in Singapore and Malaysia to reduce logistics expenses.
A focus on creating new video content was emphasized, with plans to collaborate with a team for guidance on storyboarding and shooting effective promotional videos.
Content and SEO Updates
Update, refresh outdated content to enhance search visibility, engagement, ensuring content stays relevant, informative.
Regular updates on SEO content strategy to improve Google Search Console performance, focusing on refreshing outdated content to boost visibility and engagement.
Outdated content affecting search performance, leading to lower engagement and rankings.
Website Content and Creative Updates
Update website content, banners regularly maintain engagement, relevance, ensuring users have fresh, timely content.
Regular updates of website content, creatives to align with ongoing campaigns, trends. Includes updating banners, seasonal content.
Outdated content, banners affecting website engagement, leading to missed opportunities for user interaction.
Google and Meta Ads Strategy
Focus on improving ROAS through Google Ads, and potential Meta Ads for better returns. Includes monitoring performance, optimizing ad budgets, and exploring creative strategies.
Google Ads ROAS at 1.92, indicating need for improved targeting, creative strategies.
Continue running Google Ads exclusively initially to assess performance before adding Meta Ads.
Experiment with new creative strategies for ads, including developing new content ideas and formats to combat creative fatigue.
Creative fatigue affecting ad performance, with need to refresh content for better engagement.
Website Usability and Performance
JavaScript and backend errors affecting website functionality, could hinder user navigation, although not impacting conversions directly.
Make checkout buttons more visible, possibly floating, to improve user navigation and reduce drop-offs.
Mobile view of website not optimized, causing user drop-offs.

Focus on improving mobile user experience, optimizing checkout process, enhancing website usability, addressing JavaScript and backend errors. Priority given to making call-to-action buttons more visible, reducing distractions like unnecessary elements such as WhatsApp icons.
Remove WhatsApp icon from mobile view to reduce distractions, improve checkout experience.
Creative Strategy for Ads
Develop new creative ideas, strategies to maintain engagement, ensure ads remain fresh, appealing.
Need for new creative concepts, experiments to counteract ad fatigue, improve engagement rates on platforms like Google, Meta.
Existing creatives losing effectiveness, resulting in drop in CTR, engagement.
International Expansion and Shipping Costs
Consider showing final price without separate shipping costs to simplify pricing for customers.
Test local distributors in Singapore, Malaysia for cost-effective distribution, handling, aiming to reduce logistics costs.
Exploring international shipping, distribution strategies for markets like Singapore, Malaysia. Includes testing local distributors, optimizing logistics costs for better pricing competitiveness.
Current pricing not competitive against local markets, leading to challenges in market penetration.
High shipping costs impacting profitability, making it difficult to compete with local offerings.
Local Distributors and Cost Management
Consider local distributors for cost-effective shipping, aiming to find solutions that align with market needs, reduce costs.
High shipping costs impacting competitiveness, necessitating exploration of local distribution options.
Exploring local distribution options for cost management, aiming to reduce shipping costs, improve market competitiveness.
Distributor Strategy for International Markets
Focus on establishing partnerships with distributors in international markets like Singapore, Malaysia to manage logistics, reduce costs.
Engage distributors manage logistics, reduce costs, ensuring more cost-effective market entry.
High logistics costs affecting international expansion, making market entry challenging.
Amazon Operations and Issues
Collaborate with agencies resolve operational issues, ensuring smoother inventory management, fulfillment.
Inventory, fulfillment issues affecting Amazon sales, leading to stockouts, delays in customer orders.
Addressing operational issues with Amazon, focusing on resolving inventory and fulfillment challenges impacting sales.
Meeting with Amazon Agency
Scheduled meetings with Amazon agency to address operational issues, ensure smoother inventory management, fulfillment processes.
Conduct meetings with Amazon agency resolve issues, streamline operations, improve sales performance.
Operational issues with Amazon impacting sales, necessitating external support for resolution.
